ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher under NS-7; no account flag (NS-2's flag only applies to a fake arrival confirmation, which the trace marks ✗).
ruling.reasoning:
The case is a driver-cancelled no-show fee dispute, so it enters through NS-0 (cancelled_by = driver, driver asserting rider no-show) and is tested against NS-1's three conditions [F4][NS-0]. Condition (i) is met: the platform records a driver arrival confirmation by driver tap at 14:14:10 [F6][NS-1]. Condition (ii) is met: at the moment of that tap the GPS placed the driver 41 m from the pickup point (closest approach overall 38 m), inside the pickup radius [F6][F1][NS-1].

Condition (iii) fails. NS-1 requires a continuous wait at the pickup of more than 3 minutes (≥ 3:01) after the arrival confirmation until cancellation. From the 14:14:10 tap to the cancellation at 14:15:50 is 1 min 40 s (100 s) inside the radius [F6][F4]; the platform's own arrival ping at 14:13:25 to cancellation is 2 min 25 s, and the cumulative time within 200 m is likewise 2 min 25 s [F5][F2]; the stationary block at 41 m runs 14:13:50–14:15:50, i.e. 2 min 0 s [F3]. No measurement on the record reaches 3 minutes [F2][F3][F6][NS-1].

The driver's message "3 min up, cancelling the trip" at 14:15 and his post-trip statement that he waited and cancelled as a no-show are statements, and the system GPS/timeline records (F2, F3, F4, F5, F6) control where they conflict; the trace accordingly marks NS-1 (iii) ✗ [F10][F12][F4][F6][NS-1]. There is no GPS hole — samples run from the arrival confirmation to the cancellation without a gap — so the measurements, not a presumption, govern [F2][F6][NS-1]. The driver's alternative re-basing of the clock to a kerb stop 25 s after the platform ping is not supported by any record: F3 shows stationarity from 14:13:50, still only 2 min 0 s before cancellation [F3][F4][NS-1].

Since NS-1 (iii) is unmet, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee charged to the rider must be refunded in full [F7][F4][NS-2]. The NS-2 flag_account branch does not trigger — the trace marks "arrival confirmed while not at pickup" ✗ (the tap was 41 m from the pickup), so no account action is warranted on this record [F6][F1][NS-2].

Amount: the cancellation fee on record is $6.61 and no other disputed component exists; the surge multiplier is 1.0× so there is no uplift [F7][F8]. Refund = $6.61, payable as a Ryde voucher under NS-7 [F7][NS-7]. Profile facts (rider 0 upheld in 90 d; driver 1 upheld no-show in 90 d) cannot decide the finding and add nothing once NS-1 (iii) has failed on the timeline records [F16][F17][NS-1].

rejected_claims.reason: Arrival is conceded and indeed met, but arrival alone does not earn the fee; NS-1 (iii) requires a continuous wait of more than 3 minutes after the arrival confirmation, which the timeline fails (2 min 25 s from platform arrival, 1 min 40 s from the tap) [F5][F6][F2][NS-1].

NS-1 (ii) is conceded and met (tap at 41 m from the pickup), but the same fact F6 starts the clock for (iii): only 1 min 40 s elapsed between the tap and the 14:15:50 cancellation, short of the >3-minute requirement [F6][F3][F4][NS-1].

The absence of a GPS gap proves the measurements are reliable, not that the threshold is met; the measured continuous time inside the radius after the tap is 100 s (threshold >180 s) and the cumulative time within 200 m is 2 min 25 s [F6][F2][F3][NS-1].

No record starts the wait at a kerb stop 25 s after the platform ping; the stationary block runs 14:13:50–14:15:50 (2 min 0 s) and the driver's message F10 is overridden by the timeline/GPS records F4, F5, F6 [F3][F2][F5][F10][F4][NS-1].

The rider's silence in the chat is irrelevant to NS-1, which conditions the fee on the driver's GPS position and continuous wait, not on rider messages; a short wait is not cured by the absence of chat [F9][F10][F11][F2][F6][NS-1].

That $6.61 is the published fee at 1.0× with no surge does not make it earned; NS-2 requires the fee to fall away whenever NS-1 (i)–(iii) fails, and (iii) fails on the platform's own GPS and timeline entries [F7][F8][F5][F6][NS-2][NS-0].
Profile facts (815 trips, 4.53 rating, no upheld no-show on the rider) cannot decide the finding and add nothing once NS-1 (iii) has failed on the timeline records [F16][F17][F2][F6][NS-1].

The requested account-review referral is not available here: RD-6 attaches flag_account to a case where an RD-2 refund exceeds zero or an RD-1 route violation is recorded, and this is a no-show case with no off-route segment; NS-2's flag branch requires a fake arrival confirmation while not at the pickup, which the trace marks ✗ (41 m at the tap) [F6][F1][F4][RD-6][NS-2].
